summary: PostgreSQL JDBC calls select current_catalog during DatabaseMetaData.getColumns; FusionDB must return a non-null catalog such as fusiondb.
Extended Describe must return RowDescription for metadata queries such as SHOW server_version, otherwise JDBC receives DataRow without field structure.
PostgreSQL JDBC Statement path expects text results when Bind result format codes are empty; tokio-postgres tests relied on binary fallback, so format selection must be client/protocol aware.
JDBC commit/rollback may arrive through extended protocol; transaction control statements must manipulate the active session transaction in execute_first_statement.
Real PostgreSQL JDBC driver smoke passed with connect metadata, prepared query, catalog queries, and commit/rollback checks.
